2440-3490-8249.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2440-3490-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo on the battlefield.
Repeat.
2440-3490-8249.notes: If there is at least one other Servo on the battlefield to start the combo, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

883-2527-4076-4279-4549.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-2527-4076-4279-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2511-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2511-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-6965-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

728-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1170-3536-5131-6797--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cheering Fanatic does not have summoning sickness.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3536-5131-6797--202.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name the artifact.
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2

1379-2685-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2685-5641-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-1849-3099-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

413-7124-7760.easyPrerequisites: You've discarded at least one card this turn.
413-7124-7760.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-7124-7760.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Living Laser as attackers.
Living Laser triggers, creating at least one creature token.
When the token(s) enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-3944-6972.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Blood Pet ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

2158-3525-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv by tapping it, adding {U}.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

813-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-2750-4428-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
2388-2750-4428-6587.description:
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

2266-3430-5268.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by tapping it, adding three snow mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by paying {1}{S}, untapping it.
Repeat.

997-4681-5170-6273.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

436-4890-5220.description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Dack's Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Dack's Duplicate dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Dack's Duplicate from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Dack's Duplicate onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-5240-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-5078-5240-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2292-3234-3293-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2292-3234-3293-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat
2292-3234-3293-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2173-5073-5220-6578.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
2173-5073-5220-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

81-4613-4968-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1308-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
1308-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
1308-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2921-4435-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2921-4435-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-4885.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-2527-3143-5686.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2178-2527-3143-5686.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Xavier Sal trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

1792-3459--44.notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
1792-3459--44.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting Battered Golem.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
When the artifact enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, returning the artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

862-997-5220-5683.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crimson Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1636-3143-6160.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token with base power 3 or less.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-6160.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of a creature token you control with base power 3 or less.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Overseer of Vault 76 trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Overseer of Vault 76 trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

1636-2921-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2921-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1819-4211-5510-5514.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of copies of Persistent Petitioners in your library greater than your maximum hand size minus the number of cards in your hand.
1819-4211-5510-5514.description:
Cast Secret Salvage by paying {3}{B}{B}, exiling Persistent Petitioners from your graveyard and causing you to search your library for all copies of Persistent Petitioners in your library and put them into your hand.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard as many copies of Persistent Petitioners as possible.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card discarded this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card exiled this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

1777-1869-2171-2493.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {2}{B}{B}.
Cast Persist by paying {1}{B}, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Inalla.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste.
The token Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Persist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Archaeomancer tokens, if Inalla is on the battlefield, you may activate Inalla's ability infinite times to cause infinite lifeloss for opponents.
